Pet Care Tracker

Track pet care: feeding, walks, vet visits and medications per pet.

Latest per pet

Activity log

📖 How to use

  1. Add a pet with the Add Pet field.
  2. Select the pet and the activity type (feeding, walk, vet, medication).
  3. Add details/notes and click Log Activity.
  4. Check the per-pet summary and full log below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I log pet care?

Add your pet's name first, then log activities: select the pet, choose feeding/walk/vet/medication, and save.

How do I track medication?

The medication type stores the medicine name and dose in the note field — the log keeps a dated record of every dose.

What does the summary show?

The latest entry per pet and activity type is summarized at the top.

Where is the data stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
